gen-dafont-zag-fs-epilogue: Zag sets tight, bold letters with wide mouths that stay crisp when small, while Epilogue brings curvy, wire-thin monoline strokes beneath it. What stands out most is how similarly the two are built.
gen-eater-gf-quando: Wide gaps between letters give Eater a dark, aggressive sprawl, its thin strokes close in weight to the stems. Quando, a bookish text serif, spaces its big-bodied words just as loosely.
gen-fredoka-fs-bespoke-slab: Fredoka draws friendly letters with one steady pen width and an open e. Bespoke Slab, a grounded, refined serif, lifts its lowercase high, so extended reading feels settled and unhurried.
gen-fredoka-gf-andada-pro: Andada Pro, a bookish serif, has moderate stroke modulation and counters the eye slips through. Andada Pro leaves the display work up top to Fredoka, whose pen width never varies.
gen-fredoka-gf-aref-ruqaa: Friendly Fredoka bends each letter from a single length of wire, with an open e. And Aref Ruqaa meets that wire-like line with open, dignified bowls and mild shading, a difference that defines the pair.
gen-fredoka-gf-aref-ruqaa-ink: Aref Ruqaa Ink is a literary text serif, lightly modulated, with no harsh thin spots. But under Fredoka, whose pen holds one width, paragraphs read smoothly with nothing snagging the eye.
gen-gf-metamorphous-gf-sofia-sans-semi-c: Sofia Sans Semi Condensed draws true monoline strokes, with lowercase that nearly matches the capitals in height. Metamorphous does the commanding, softly shaded display; the sans does the quiet work.
gen-mystery-quest-gf-sono: Sono spaces its letters generously and leaves each lowercase a with its mouth ajar, giving a professional but approachable voice. Mystery Quest opens the scene nostalgic and bookish, and Sono carries the rest.
gen-press-start-2p-gf-stack-sans-text: Press Start 2P feels fun and retro, its letters pinned far apart. Stack Sans Text draws a flat, marker-like line, leaving Press Start 2P to the big, brief words up top.
gen-righteous-gf-stack-sans-notch: Thin steel rod, bent into every letter, gives Righteous its commanding, playful look. Stack Sans Notch, a sans-serif, carries the rod idea on with identical thickness throughout and curves open to the eye.
